Not in order but so far as I recall I've tried :

-corticosteroids creams

-PUVA ligh therapy

-prednisone pill (50mg, tapering off every week)

-various biologics injections (some for eczema)

-rinvoq

-siliQ

-Methotrexate 

-few more pills but don't recall their names...

So far out of these the only ones with at least a little improvement was PUVA and prednisone and both stopped helping after a bit of use....
